name: B10-0129/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for action on the violence in eastern Congo, where the M23 rebel group, backed by Rwandan troops, has captured towns and committed killings and rapes. It asks the EU to suspend its minerals deal with Rwanda, ban weapons exports to Rwanda, and consider a trade embargo on Rwandan minerals until Rwandan forces leave Congo. It also wants sanctions on military commanders and better tracking of minerals entering the EU.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is asking the EU to suspend the Rwanda minerals deal, ban arms sales and sanction commanders.
- **Who it affects:** Rwanda's government and army, M23 commanders, EU companies importing minerals, and people in eastern Congo.
- **What happens next:** The EU Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
